name: BERLIN LAUGHS 2026 - International Street Theater Festival
description: Berlin's wildest free open-air cultural event transforms public space with international street theater, circus, comedy, clowns, performers, magicians, dance and music. The festival is dedicated to bringing street culture and performance art to Berlin in a completely non-elitist way, ensuring even those who aren't usually theater-goers can experience the art form. Entirely self-funded without city support, the festival operates on passion and risk-taking, featuring a beer garden, food trucks, urban gardening, and upcycling installations alongside the performances.
